cell 47  [markdown]

## HERA — fan precursor: low-field extension of run 6 (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² D = 0, B 0.3 → 1.3 T at 5 mT

> **05:26** · sdh-spot-check low-field extension of run 6: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0.3->1.3 T uniform 5 mT (201 pts), delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 1.3 T; pins the 7.5 T tone onset -> fan B\_lo · **ETA ~05:48** (≈22 min)

**Where the arc stands.** Runs 6/7 (spot checks, both signs at D = 0) are read (ana). Electron side, n = +3.2×10¹²: a tone comb at **7.47 / 14.94 / 22.41 / 29.88 T** (exact 1:2:3:4) against F_L = 33.1 T. Two readings survive: (a) one 7.5 T fundamental with strong harmonics (would break the Luttinger sum — only 23 % of the density in a resolved pocket), or (b) the ABAB pair + sum tone — model ABAB at n = 3.2: 7.3 / 25.7 T, ratio 3.5 (→ 4.8 at n = 2.0), so a real heavy pocket **leaves the 3× comb as n drops** while a harmonic tracks 3× exactly. That n-dependence is the fan's read (investigation Step 4/5) — the **electron-side fan is next**. Hole side (run 7, |n| ≤ 1.27 reachable) is the low-|n| exception regime by the model (ABAB 6.4/6.8 T unresolvable pair; ABCA m* > 1 mₑ, LK-dead) — a preview, not a discriminator.

**Why this cell first.** The fan's carrying (slowest) tone is 7.5 T, and `sdh_onset` on run 6 reports it **censored** — alive down to the record's usable edge; below ~0.85 T run 6's 50 mT leg under-samples it (Nyquist F < B²/0.1), so its onset is unmeasured. `landau-fan` step 1: a censored carrying tone's onset is a lower bound on B_lo — pin it with a cheap low-field extension before committing the fan. It decides B_lo = 0.7 vs 1.0 T, ≈ 80 min of fan rows (Δ(1/B) rows are dense at low B), for ~20 min on a ramp the fan takes anyway. Same spot as run 6 (V_tg +0.984, V_bg +1.166), same 50 µV scale (R < 60 Ω here), 5 mT uniform-B (Nyquist 9 T at 0.3 T — the 22 T tone aliases only below ~0.55 T, below its own 1.3 T onset; stated). Ends at **1.3 T with the gates at the spot**; the fan starts from there.

**Price:** 201 pts × ≈ 5.6 s (5 mT ramp 2.2 s + 3 s driver settle + reads; run 6 calibrates 7.8 s/pt at 10 mT) ≈ 19 min + 0 → 0.3 T ramp 2 min ≈ **22 min**. Checkpoint: first 20 points (signal present, sensitivity, leakage, field tracking). Preconditions in-cell: T_sample 1.0–1.5 K, |B| < 0.05 T (handoff left 0 T), V_si = 0, PS heater on / output enabled, heater ranges 0/0.

cell 48  [code]
============================================================
```python
# === Low-field extension of run 6 (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0.3 -> 1.3 T at 5 mT — pins the censored 7.5 T tone's onset (fan B_lo) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)   # run-5 calibration (same as run 6)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
assert abs(Vtg_spot - 0.9836) < 1e-3 and abs(Vbg_spot - 1.1661) < 1e-3, "spot differs from run 6"
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V (run-6 point)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left 0 T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0

# --- field grid: uniform in B, 5 mT, 0.3 -> 1.3 T (Nyquist at 0.3 T: d(1/B) = 0.056 -> 9 T > the 7.5 T tone; overlaps run 6's 10 mT leg 1.0-1.3 T)
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.3, 1.3001, 0.005), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # same scale as run 6 (5 kOhm FS; R < 60 Ohm here)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron, low-field extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.3 -> 1.3 T, 5 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, low-field extension of run 6 (onset of the censored 7.5 T tone): n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 0.3 -> 1.3 T uniform-B 5 mT; cal run 5')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot, field stays at 1.3 T — the fan starts from here (B_lo set by this run's onset read).
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
```

      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0

# --- field grid: uniform in B, 5 mT, 0.3 -> 1.3 T (Nyquist at 0.3 T: d(1/B) = 0.056 -> 9 T > the 7.5 T tone; overlaps run 6's 10 mT leg 1.0-1.3 T)

assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
